title: langfuse_row_record.v1
description: Content-minimized Langfuse row analysis and whole-file private capture outcomes. The complete selected originals are retained, including possible headers and text. Stored-byte verification is not producer authentication or approval. Null published_record means no returned identity, not proven absence.

langfuse_row_index.title: langfuse_row_index.v2
langfuse_row_index.description: Selected Langfuse array/blob or CLI-list rows; producer version and source windows remain unknown. The reader family is an Underwrite policy, not origin proof.

evidence_error.title: evidence_error.v1
evidence_error.description: Invocation or input failure of an evidence pilot command. No successful report was emitted. This is not a measurement verdict.

record_error.title: record_error.v1
record_error.description: Finite records command failure without caller-supplied diagnostics.

record_verification.title: record_verification.v1
record_verification.description: Stored-byte and direct-link integrity findings; valid false is result data, not invocation failure.

findings.description: At most one deterministic P2 runtime-selected finding per file or direct link; runtime precedence owns coordinate uniqueness.

langfuse_blob_row_index.title: langfuse_row_index.v1
langfuse_blob_row_index.description: Content-minimized structural view of two independently selected exports.

langfuse_cli_row_index.title: langfuse_cli_row_index.v1
langfuse_cli_row_index.description: Content-minimized ordinal view over the same selected CLI rows.
